tags.WHAT: Strong rip currents. Minor tidal overflows, especially during the late morning high tides.
tags.WHERE: Catalina and Santa Barbara Islands, Ventura County Beaches, Malibu Coast and Los Angeles County Beaches.
tags.IMPACTS: Pooling of sea water is possible around high tide at beach and harbor areas that is uncommon with normal tidal ranges. Enhanced beach erosion is also possible. No significant damage is expected. Rip currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea.
